build_transformer_predictor: build a transformer predictor for searchless chess with configurable architecture and positional encodings
train_predictor: train a transformer predictor on chess data using JAX with Adam optimizer and gradient clipping
build_evaluator: build a chess metrics evaluator to measure action accuracy, log loss, and Kendall tau correlation
build_data_loader: build a PyGrain data loader for chess sequences with configurable batch size and shuffling
run_training_script: run the searchless chess training script with action_value, state_value, or behavioral_cloning policy
